claim: The status instruction's effect slot takes a bare known name, or the @status-<name> constant (v160+); @<name>, status-<name> and unknown names are silent no-ops.
why: v160.x: LParser normalises a bare known name to the @status-<name> constant and LExecutor$ApplyEffectI carries the slot as a LVar (so a variable holding @status-wet works too); the @status- literals appear in 5 classes of the v160 jar and 0 of the v159 jar. v159.3 accepts only the bare name. Both executors measured, see out/takeover-20261024/20-status-effect-slot-forms.md. Replaces the refuted status-name-needs-at, whose inverted claim fired 3392 times in the 2026-10-25 sweep.
